notes: Issue #538 runs design-lint in this skill. Run each case once against 860894fc and once against the #538 branch, in an isolated session that loads one copy of the plugin, at one model for both arms. Use the fixture: A product repository with one static page, index.html, and styles.css. The page has a hint line in #b8b8b8 on white (a WP-13a and A11Y-1 failure), and a link whose text is 'click here' (WO-10c, and the judged rule WO-10d). design-lint.config.json sets serve to '.', pages.all to ['/'], and the WP-13a selectors to empty strings. Deny every install and every remote call. Assertions carry passed=null until a run fills them in.

evals.name: pattern-pass-follows-pass-md
evals.prompt: /dx-harness:dx-design-pattern Improve the pattern of the consent forms page (index.html). It is a static page with no server: the folder itself is the site. This is an unattended run: ask me nothing, treat every finding as declined so nothing is built, use the local markdown fallback for the design ticket, and change no product file. List the rules you judged, and say what you do with a gap that no rule covers.
evals.expected_output: The pass reads pass.md, judges inside its dimension, records up to five findings on the local ticket, and sends an uncovered gap to a rule proposal per rule-proposal.md.

assertions.text: The reply lists five findings or fewer, inside the dimension
The reply sends an uncovered gap to a rule proposal
